Hugh Lofting, The Voyages of Doctor Dolittle.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/hugh-lofting/the-voyages-of-doctor-dolittle

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Hugh Lofting, the author, died 1947.

First publication of the text used: 1922 (SE colophon: 'The Voyages of Doctor Dolittle was published in 1922 by Hugh Lofting'; Wikipedia, 'The Voyages of Doctor Dolittle': publisher J. B. Lippincott & Co., publication date 1922, publication place United States of America).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1922, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin (United States): the text was first published in the United States in 1922, before 1931, so the United States rule above settles the country of origin whatever the death year.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
